answer: The 2026 target is operated net Scope 1+2 emissions below 34 MtCO2e, from 46 MtCO2e in 2015. The 2030 target is a 40% reduction from 2015, corresponding to 25–30 MtCO2e. It applies to the operated perimeter and uses market-based Scope 2. This perimeter represented 75% of the ESRS-perimeter GHG emissions in 2025. Nature-based carbon-sink credits may contribute only from 2030, at about 5 Mt per year; through 2029 net equals gross.

evidence.quote: Net Scope 1+2 emissions ... 2015 46 Mt CO2e; 2026 target <34 Mt CO2e; 2030 target -40% (25 to 30 Mt CO2e); market-based; operated perimeter; 75%.
Until 2029 included, net emissions are equal to gross emissions (no use of nature-based carbon sinks projects before 2030).
